items.title: Prime Minister's Visit to Netherlands
items.whyInNews: Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited the Netherlands and held talks with Dutch Prime Minister Rob Jetten. The visit aimed to strengthen bilateral ties between India and the Netherlands.
items.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited the Netherlands on May 17, 2026, and held delegation-level talks with Dutch Prime Minister Rob Jetten.
